category.name: Developer platforms and DevOps
category.description: Source control, deployment, cloud infrastructure, monitoring and incident management.

entries.name: AWS APIs
entries.auth_hint: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) signed request using IAM access key/secret or STS temporary credentials
entries.free_tier: new accounts get up to $200 in credits plus free usage of 90+ services for up to 6 months; some services also have a perpetual Always Free tier
entries.desc_en: An agent can provision and control thousands of AWS resources (compute, storage, databases, ML) via SDKs/CLI/REST.
entries.notes: Umbrella platform: hundreds of distinct service APIs, each with its own IAM scoping, rate limits, and regional availability; no single unified OpenAPI spec.

entries.name: Azure APIs
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD OAuth2)
entries.free_tier: 12 months of select free services plus $200 credit for 30 days for new accounts; many services also have a permanent always-free monthly amount
entries.desc_en: An agent can deploy and manage Azure resources (compute, storage, databases, AI) across resource-provider REST APIs.
entries.notes: Umbrella platform: hundreds of resource-provider APIs, each independently versioned (api-version query param required); the Azure MCP repo moved from Azure/azure-mcp (archived) to microsoft/mcp.

entries.name: CircleCI API
entries.free_tier: free plan: 30,000 credits/month (~6,000 build minutes on a small Docker resource class), credits expire monthly
entries.desc_en: An agent can trigger pipelines, rerun workflows, fetch logs/test results, and validate CI/CD configuration via REST.
entries.notes: CircleCI recommends the v3 API for new development; v2 remains supported. The CircleCI-Public/mcp-server-circleci npm package is deprecated in favor of CircleCI's newer hosted MCP server / CLI MCP mode, whose exact endpoint could not be confirmed from fetchable docs at research time.

entries.name: Cloudflare API
entries.free_tier: free with any Cloudflare account; API access itself is free, manages both free and paid Cloudflare products
entries.desc_en: An agent can manage DNS, Workers, zones, WAF/security rules, and caching for Cloudflare accounts programmatically.
entries.notes: Global rate limit ~1,200 requests/5 min per user; per-IP limit ~200 req/sec; GraphQL Analytics API has a separate cost-based limit. Legacy X-Auth-Key global key auth also exists but is discouraged.

entries.name: Datadog API
entries.auth_hint: DD-API-KEY: <api_key> plus DD-APPLICATION-KEY: <app_key> for some endpoints
entries.free_tier: free Infrastructure Monitoring plan: 1-day metric retention, up to 5 hosts; other products (APM, Logs, Security) are paid
entries.desc_en: An agent can query metrics, logs, traces, monitors, and dashboards, and manage Datadog configuration via REST.
entries.notes: Datadog MCP server endpoint is site-specific (app.datadoghq.com, datadoghq.eu, etc.); supports OAuth2, personal/service tokens, or DD-API-KEY/DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers.

entries.name: Docker Hub API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <token> (obtained via login or a Personal/Organization Access Token)
entries.free_tier: free personal accounts with rate-limited image pulls; paid Pro/Team/Business tiers raise pull limits
entries.desc_en: An agent can search, push, pull, tag, and manage container images and repositories on Docker Hub.
entries.notes: API is labeled v2-beta; rate limits apply to anonymous/free image pulls. Docker also has a broader official MCP Catalog/Toolkit (docs.docker.com/ai/mcp-catalog-and-toolkit/) with 300+ containerized MCP servers.

entries.name: Fly.io Machines API
entries.free_tier: no perpetual free tier; pay-as-you-go billing with trial credit for new accounts
entries.desc_en: An agent can create, start, stop, and destroy Fly.io Machines (lightweight VMs) programmatically via REST.
entries.notes: The official MCP server ships under Fly.io's Sprites product, adjacent to but distinct from the core Machines API.

entries.name: GitHub API
entries.free_tier: free with any GitHub account; 5,000 req/hr authenticated, 60/hr unauthenticated
entries.desc_en: An agent can manage repositories, issues, pull requests, releases, and code search via REST or GraphQL.
entries.notes: Rate limits scale with auth type (60/hr unauth, 5,000/hr PAT, higher for GitHub Apps); secondary abuse limits also apply; GraphQL uses a separate points-based limit.

entries.name: GitLab API
entries.free_tier: free tier: full REST API access on GitLab.com Free plan; some features gated to Premium/Ultimate
entries.desc_en: An agent can manage projects, issues, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, and repository files via REST/GraphQL.
entries.notes: GitLab's official MCP server is in beta (GitLab 18.6+); no GitLab-maintained multi-language SDK, but popular community libraries (python-gitlab, node-gitlab) exist.

entries.name: Google Cloud APIs
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 access token> (service account or Application Default Credentials); API keys for select public APIs
entries.free_tier: free trial credit for new customers plus an Always Free tier with perpetual no-cost limits on select products
entries.desc_en: An agent can create and manage Google Cloud resources (compute, storage, data, AI/ML) via REST, gRPC, or client libraries.
entries.notes: Umbrella platform: hundreds of distinct service APIs, each with its own scopes/quotas; many APIs require explicit per-project enabling. MCP Toolbox for Databases is Google's main official MCP offering (Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, BigQuery, Spanner).

entries.name: Netlify API
entries.free_tier: free Starter plan; API usage subject to account plan limits
entries.desc_en: An agent can create/manage sites, trigger and monitor deploys, and configure DNS, domains, and env vars.
entries.notes: Rate limits: 500 req/min general, 3 deploys/min (100/day). Tokens are invalidated on password reset.

entries.name: PagerDuty API
entries.free_tier: free plan for up to 5 users: 100 monthly SMS/phone notifications, 1 on-call schedule, 1 escalation policy, API access
entries.desc_en: An agent can create/manage incidents, on-call schedules, escalation policies, and services via REST.
entries.notes: The linked pagerduty-mcp-server GitHub repo is deprecated/read-only; PagerDuty has moved MCP development to a hosted Remote MCP Server with OAuth, but its exact endpoint URL could not be confirmed from fetchable docs at research time.

entries.name: Postman API
entries.free_tier: free plan available; rate limits ~300 req/min general, stricter for specific endpoints
entries.desc_en: An agent can manage Postman collections, workspaces, environments, mocks, monitors, and API specs via REST.
entries.notes: The given candidate homepage is a UI workspace, not docs; the official docs.postman.com/learning.postman.com site is the real reference. Postman's confirmed official MCP endpoint is oriented at querying Postman's own docs/learning content, distinct from a full account-management MCP.

entries.name: Render API
entries.free_tier: free static sites; free web services that spin down after inactivity
entries.desc_en: An agent can create and manage Render services, trigger deployments, and configure databases and env vars.
entries.notes: OpenAPI spec endpoint/tag names may change over time even though the API itself stays backward compatible. Render's official MCP server supports potentially destructive operations (env var changes, triggering deploys).

entries.name: Sentry API
entries.free_tier: free Developer plan: 1 user, 5,000 errors/mo, 5GB logs, 50 replays; includes MCP access
entries.desc_en: An agent can query and triage error/performance issues and manage projects, releases, and org data.
entries.notes: API is v0 (public endpoints stable, beta endpoints may change); per-endpoint rate limits via X-Sentry-Rate-Limit-* headers; legacy Basic-auth API keys are deprecated in favor of Bearer auth tokens.

entries.name: Supabase Management API
entries.free_tier: free plan available; rate limit 120 req/min per user/project (lower for heavier endpoints)
entries.desc_en: An agent can programmatically create and manage Supabase projects, databases, API keys, and config.
entries.notes: Personal Access Tokens carry full account privileges - treat as highly sensitive. Client SDKs (javascript, python, dart, swift, kotlin) are for the data/auth/storage APIs, not the Management API.

entries.name: Vercel API
entries.free_tier: free on Hobby plan; some resources/endpoints require Pro/paid plan
entries.desc_en: An agent can create deployments, manage projects/domains/env vars, and query analytics and logs.
entries.notes: Vercel MCP (Beta) is remote/OAuth-based; write actions like deployments or purchases require explicit OAuth consent.
